# PickerWheel.world

PickerWheel.world is a free browser-based random picker wheel for choosing names and options, making low-stakes decisions, and running classroom or group activities.

## Main tool
- [Random picker wheel, name selector, decision wheel, coin flip and random number use cases.](https://www.pickerwheel.world/)

## Editorial notes
The guides are practical educational resources. Random selection is appropriate for many low-stakes activities, but should not replace consent, safety procedures, legal requirements, or expert judgment for high-stakes decisions. Please use the live page as the source of truth for current tool functionality and site policies.
